procedure: Read the assigned whole image and anonymous box list, then ran prepare_second.py 088 exactly once with no rotations. Visually inspected all 19 saved crops. B001 was reopened once to check its compressed opening words; no crop was regenerated. No first.tsv, witness, draft, approved page, report, hand log, root decisions or comparison was opened.
general_scope: The TSV contains the principal complete passage of each anonymous box; clipped neighbouring baselines are excluded. B002 records the full diagram, including eight endpoint numerals 1, the label 26, the vertical equality, both angled isomorphism signs and the two Galois annotations. Diagram row spacing is an encoding device only; notes identify uncertain endpoints and overwritten state. No inferred exactness or other mathematical expectation was used to add arrowheads or repair signs.

boxes.scope: Both introductory text lines; the tops of diagram arrows and numerals below are handled in B002.
boxes.evidence: First word is le. The next group has a tall crossed initial stroke and short separated low returns; trace is preferred, with tout retained because the compressed middle cannot be fully separated. The next d-led group is very short, favouring ds, with dans left open. un diagramme de suites exactes is readable. No stop is visible after exactes.

boxes.scope: Entire diagram, with its number and all side annotations.
boxes.evidence: There are two upper 1 nodes, two endpoint 1s in each horizontal sequence, and two lower 1 nodes. The top horizontal relation has a waved upper and straight lower stroke. Right upper node reads I with s-prime and a simeq T continuation. A two-stroke vertical equality stands between the two pi nodes. Top row first two connectors have two-arm heads, whereas the middle connector has only a terminal return and is rendered as a shaft. In the lower row the first two connectors and the connector between the E terms lack secure independent heads and are rendered as shafts. The rightward endpoint connectors and terminal downward arrows have heads. The two middle downward connectors have tiny terminal returns but no separately secure heads, so shafts are preferred. Their arrow interpretation remains possible. The right-hand annotations read Gal(bar K / tilde K) and Gal(bar k / k), with slanted simeq glyphs above-left. The main right upper subscript is a branched K; the smaller nested subscript under U is eta-like but K remains an alternative. The closed oval lower subscripts are rendered as 0, without inferring a different name. Left upper overwritten node has the unresolved state detailed in B003.

boxes.scope: Whole overwritten left upper diagram node.
boxes.evidence: A central upright and long top and bottom bars support I; a small s-like curve and raised prime remain at lower right. Heavy retracing and a diagonal/curved stroke down the right side can be a cancellation or an overwritten D-like outline. Stroke order cannot be recovered securely. The TSV therefore leaves live I_s-prime versus deleted I_s-prime explicit, rather than inventing a separate replacement or certain underlying D.
First digit has rounded upper bend, low turn and rising foot of 2. Second has a high stroke and closed lower loop of 6. Both parentheses are clear.

boxes.scope: le noyau, raised addition, de, and whole pair of E terms.
boxes.evidence: A raised I-shaped sign, with top bar, descending stem and short foot, is attached by the insertion leader between noyau and de. The first nested subscript is a compact arch with a long side and shallow tilde, favouring eta but not excluding K. The second is a closed oval under tilde. The connector has only a short end return; plain shaft is preferred, arrow retained as an alternative.

boxes.scope: Whole principal phrase from I_s-prime through the final period.
boxes.evidence: s and its prime are distinct below I. After lui there is a short hyphen and a two-stroke equality-like sign; these are transcribed literally rather than expanded into a word. Its upper stroke is straighter than the lower, so equality is preferred but simeq remains possible. Both abbreviation stops in can. isom. are visible. The small a body and grave-like upper mark support à. T and its following period are clear.

boxes.scope: La section de, full raised insertion, following E/N identification and final dotted sign.
boxes.evidence: The curved insertion leader joins the gap after de to the raised E_U term and sur, before the live E_tildeK term. The nested subscript stays eta/K doubtful. The main K has a straight stem and two distinct branches. The relation has wavy upper and straight lower strokes. N has a lowered s and raised prime. The isolated following mark has a dot above a long curved stem, favouring j; a long semicolon remains possible, and no extra comma has been supplied.

boxes.scope: Both complete E terms and intervening sur.
boxes.evidence: No tilde or bar is visible over either eta. The first is nested beneath U, the second directly below E. Both have an upright/arch and a descending right return. sur consists of a curved s and joined low ur movements.

boxes.scope: Opening parenthesis through par; the continuation occurs in B010.
boxes.evidence: elle has two looped l ascenders. The following sign is literally two bars. The next word has a d ascender, tall descending f, dotted i and final e movement; accent over its first e is weak, hence the local accented/unaccented doubt. par begins with a long descending p.

boxes.scope: Raised phrase, whole point expression, remaining text and closing parenthesis.
boxes.evidence: The insertion says le pt K-rat., with a crossed t, a clearly branched capital K, hyphen and terminal period. Its curved leader reaches before the large point-name letter. That letter has a long descender and a visible crossbar, favouring f_K; j_K remains an alternative because the leader crosses nearby. U and both eta forms are unaccented. The final parenthesis is visible.

Here the smaller first subscript clearly has the long left upright and arched right part of eta, beneath a waved tilde. The lower subscript in the second term is a closed oval beneath tilde. The horizontal connector ends in a single downward return, without two separate head arms, and is read as a plain shaft.

boxes.scope: Complete principal text after the leading pi.
boxes.evidence: Pi is followed by a comma. The low group after a has a rounded first cup and second shoulder, favouring vu; un remains graphically possible. The longer final group has co, repeated low humps and a terminal crossed stem, favouring comment with commut retained. A colon is distinct. The literal reading is not expanded to a mathematical label.
essentiellement has a crossed t, dotted i and two looped l ascenders. The following p has a long descender and a joined low ar continuation. The final un is a two-shouldered low group.

boxes.scope: Whole composite formula, intervening où, and map specification.
boxes.evidence: Both initial labels have a tall stem and two arms; Latin k and Greek kappa cannot be separated by this writing, so kappa_i is preferred with k_i retained. The composition mark is a hollow circle. The first factor inside the parenthesis has a descending left stroke and low right return consistent with mu. A distinct dot precedes id, whose T is lowered. Comma follows the close, and où has a visible grave above its low ending. The final connector has a small single return; shaft is preferred and arrow remains possible. Final target is pi.

boxes.scope: Complete main line, excluding the clipped insertion underneath.
boxes.evidence: hom. has a separate period and a following hyphen. lacet has a looped l and crossed final t, followed by a comma. relatif has the tall final f descender. l’indice and a separate dotted i are visible, followed by a period.

boxes.scope: Ainsi, entire raised phrase, the live E term with adjacent deletion, and complete s’envoie; the following word is clipped at the right crop edge and is not completed.
boxes.evidence: The raised phrase le groupe de décomposition occupies the interline before the E subject and is recorded there as an insertion. The main E has a clearly branched K beneath a waved tilde. The following parenthetic group is hatched out; see B017. s’envoie has the apostrophe, low en/v/o movements, dotted i and final e.

boxes.scope: Live E_tildeK and complete adjacent cancelled parenthesis.
boxes.evidence: Both parentheses survive. A waved upper mark is visible inside, above a long descending letter whose crossbar is obscured by hatching. A lowered K-like pair of branches remains at the right. A tilded f_K is preferred, but tilded j_K remains possible. The whole cancelled reading remains doubtful because all strokes cannot be recovered.

boxes.scope: Entire equality and following comma; clipped K from the preceding line excluded.
boxes.evidence: L has a long vertical and lower horizontal foot, with a dotted i below. Equality consists of two strokes. The second label repeats the stem-and-two-arm kappa/k form and dotted index i. T is enclosed in parentheses. The final mark is one connected comma-shaped return, not a securely separate semicolon.
Two stacked loops give 8; the next numeral has a top bar, descending stroke and crossbar, giving 7.
